snippet.title: Pacific Drive: Whispers in the Woods | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The mysteries of the Olympic Exclusion Zone deepen, with more secrets and new anomalies waiting to be discovered. But that's the least of your worries -you're about to encounter a group of strange and deadly fanatics obsessed with the OEZ’s anomalies, all while dealing with their influence across the Zone. 

Whispers in the Woods is an expansion to Pacific Drive - featuring a fully voiced cast of characters, new gameplay systems, additional content, and even more terrifying secrets to uncover.

Wishlist Whispers in the Woods: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3594760/Pacific_Drive_Whispers_in_the_Woods
